"""Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")
action.new_text:
"""Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    # Validate input matrices
    for arr, name in [
        (logp_with_result, 'logp_with_result'),
        (logp_call_only, 'logp_call_only'),
        (logp_no_call, 'logp_no_call'),
    ]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.isfinite(arr).all():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
        if (arr > 0).any():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")

    # Check shape consistency
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")

    # Validate tau_filter
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter cannot be a Boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")

    # Compute average log probabilities over future horizon
    avg_with = np.mean(logp_with_result, axis=1)
    avg_call = np.mean(logp_call_only, axis=1)
    avg_no = np.mean(logp_no_call, axis=1)

    # Compute improvements over not calling and calling without result
    delta_no_call = avg_no - avg_with
    delta_call_only = avg_call - avg_with

    # Keep calls where both improvements exceed the threshold
    keep = (delta_no_call > tau_filter) & (delta_call_only > tau_filter)

    # Margin is the minimum improvement
    margins = np.minimum(delta_no_call, delta_call_only)

    return keep, margins
